SNL 语法树的主类型. 一个节点带有 name, kind, children, mdata, envMode, style, scope 等字段, 是 union 类型 (formula / text / block 三种 envMode 分支的合并). 所有 parser 输出 / serializer 输入 / 渲染消费 都走这个类型.
SnlSyntaxTree union 三个分支的共同字段基类. 包含 name (macro 名或 delim payload), kind (bvar / fvar / binder / rule / ... 或空), children (子节点数组), mdata (自由 metadata bag), style (可选样式变体名), scope (结构性作用域标记).
envMode 为 formula_inline 或 formula_display 的分支. 此时 name 字段承载 LaTeX 源码, 直接进 KaTeX 渲染.
envMode 为 text 的分支. name 字段承载文本内容, 走 React text-run 渲染 (不进 KaTeX 数学模式).
envMode 为 block 的分支. 通过 react_renderer_key 派发到具体的 block renderer, 如 list / enumerate / matrix / table 等.
template query 函数的入参. 携带 macro name + 请求的 style + envMode, 由 query 实现返回相应 style 的 LaTeX / text template 字符串.
template query 的函数签名类型 (type alias). 签名: (args: SnlMacroTemplateQueryArgs) => Promise<string>. 渲染管线通过它异步取到具体 style 的 template.
片段解析时传入的外层 binder 名称集合。

title: 本文档的 entry_kinds 决策 (元文档)

content.snl: %10 个 kind: NpmPackage / Module / Interface / Class / Field / Function / ReactComponent / Property / Constant / Concept. Interface 成员不独立成 entry (写在 content 内), Class 成员独立成 sub-entry, method 复用 Function, Property 用全称避 Lean 里 Prop=Proposition 歧义, 默认实现复用 Constant.%
content.markdown: 10 个 kind: NpmPackage / Module / Interface / Class / Field / Function / ReactComponent / Property / Constant / Concept. Interface 成员不独立成 entry (写在 content 内), Class 成员独立成 sub-entry, method 复用 Function, Property 用全称避 Lean 里 Prop=Proposition 歧义, 默认实现复用 Constant.
Globally unique name, e.g. "FOL.eq", "FOL.forall", "FOL.forall.typed"
Human-readable description shown in tooltips / docs.
Source-of-truth binding. Resolver: entries[0..] first valid, else urls[0], else null.
Semantic kind (rule / const / bvar / binder / fvar / custom). If unset, nodes rendered for this macro get `data-kind="fvar"`. (There is no more `'default'` kind — un-classified = fvar.)

True when the macro's child count is not fixed by its template — its default (styles[0]) template must contain `#*`. All styles must agree on this flag; it's a macro-level invariant so switching styles never changes the arity contract at the call site.

All render styles in order. `styles[0]` is the **implicit default** used when the SNL source omits `[style]`. In `foo[bar](x)`, the parser picks the style whose `tag === "bar"`; unknown tags are a render-time error. Every macro has at least one style. Style tags follow `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` (parser IDENT rules) and must be unique within this array.
Free-text labels attached to the macro itself — used by downstream search indices. Backslashes are forbidden. Optional.
Style tag — the token used in `foo[tag](…)`. `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` (parser IDENT rules). Must be unique within a macro's `styles` array.

Semantic render mode. Four flat parallel values (v3): - `formula_inline` — KaTeX inline math ($...$) - `formula_display` — KaTeX display math ($$...$$) - `text` — KaTeX `\text{...}`; may host formulas via `$...$` - `block` — React-rendered block (list / table / centered / …)
LaTeX-native template. See fillLatexTemplate for placeholders: #0, #1, #* (variadic), \# (literal).
`variadic_left` is an optional field of `SnlMacroStyle`. Its declared TypeScript type is `string`.
`variadic_join` is an optional field of `SnlMacroStyle`. Its declared TypeScript type is `string`.
`variadic_right` is an optional field of `SnlMacroStyle`. Its declared TypeScript type is `string`.
Block/text mode dispatch key — see hooks.tsx / block-renderers.tsx. Only applies when mode is 'block' or 'text'.
Free-text labels attached to this style — used by downstream search indices. Backslashes are forbidden. Optional.
`entries` is an field of `SnlMacroSource`. Its declared TypeScript type is `string[]`.
`urls` is an field of `SnlMacroSource`. Its declared TypeScript type is `string[]`.

content.markdown: Low-level render-mode, LaTeX, style, and HTML-data helpers.
Macro name — key into `SnlMacroDb`.
Style-tag override from the parser's `[style]` bracket, e.g. `foo[bar]` sets `style = 'bar'`. Undefined when no bracket — the view falls back to the macro's first style (`SnlMacro.styles[0]`).

Synthetic-macro environment mode set by the parser for delimited names: `%…%` → `'text'` `$…$` → `'formula_inline'` `$$…$$` → `'formula_display'` When set, the render pipeline treats this node as a TEMPORARY macro: - The `name` is a literal payload (LaTeX source or raw text) — NOT a macroDb key. - `text` → wrapped in `\text{escape(name)}`. - `formula_inline` → emitted as raw LaTeX (`name` is expected to be valid LaTeX; if it contains `$…$` KaTeX handles it normally). - `formula_display` → same as formula_inline, but also forces `katex.displayMode = true` at the root. When `envMode` is set the macroDb is NOT consulted for a template. Undefined for regular identifier-form nodes (the vast majority).
Semantic kind (rule / const / binder / bvar / fvar / …).
Structural scope marker (out of the kind namespace). annotate-bind sets `scope = 'binder'` on quantifier nodes; the view emits `data-scope` from it.

Fire-and-forget — NOT awaited. Called on hover start / move for consumer side effects (logging, host messaging). The view's internal hover state machine runs regardless. Default: undefined.
Fire-and-forget — NOT awaited. Called when the pointer leaves the render container. Default: undefined.

Async — awaited after hover starts (with a short debounce). Fine to hit a network / disk cache; the view keeps `loading: true` in the tooltip state until it resolves. Default: read macroDb[name].description.

Sync — called during render on every hover to enrich the tooltip payload. Return null when no source is resolvable. If you need async lookup, cache results in a React state / memo before construction and read synchronously here. Default: return null.
Sync React render — called during render, must be pure (no side effects). Default: SNL-Basics's built-in tooltip DOM. Return null to suppress the tooltip entirely.
